items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: There I was met at the airport by some men from the television and two German jazz fans, Hans Blutner and Fritz Krull.

ctx.x: I waited around for quite a while, and after midnight came, I still had not played anything. I decided to take a taxi and go back to the club. When I arrived, Guy was furious because I had not come back in time to do the show. As he had given me permission to go to this gig, I didn't figure that he was expecting me back at a certain time. I finished the night at the club and he told me that I was fired. He just could speak a little English, and his words for telling me I was fired, were that he was kicking me…

Soon after I finished at the Club St. Germain, I received an offer to do two concerts in Berlin and left by train for Hannover the 27th of March. When I arrived in Hannover the 28th, I took a plane to Berlin. There I was met at the airport by some men from the television and two German jazz fans, Hans Blutner and Fritz Krull. They presented me to an American boxer named Tiger Jones who was campaigning in Germany.

I had an interview at the TV and di a concert the 29th with some very good German musicians after only talking over a few numbers I wanted to play. The public was very enthusiastic and I had a great reception.
